name: oxide-sloc
description: IEEE 1045-1992 SLOC analysis across 60 languages. Counts source lines, comments, blank lines, functions, classes, and unit tests. Built entirely by AI (Claude).

SLOC_SERVER_URL.description: Base URL of a running oxide-sloc server (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:4317). Required for get_metrics_latest, get_metrics_history, get_run_metrics, health_check, and ingest_result. Not needed for analyze_path or compare_runs, which operate standalone via the oxide-sloc CLI.

SLOC_BIN.description: Absolute path to the oxide-sloc binary. Defaults to 'oxide-sloc' resolved via PATH.

SLOC_API_KEY.description: Bearer token for the oxide-sloc server when SLOC_API_KEY authentication is enabled on the server.

SLOC_MCP_ALLOWED_ROOTS.description: Allowlist of directories that analyze_path and compare_runs may read (colon-separated on Unix, semicolon on Windows). Fail-closed: if unset, path-based tools are rejected unless SLOC_MCP_UNRESTRICTED=1.

SLOC_MCP_UNRESTRICTED.description: Set to '1' to disable the SLOC_MCP_ALLOWED_ROOTS path restriction entirely (trusted local single-user use only).

tools.name: analyze_path
tools.description: Run oxide-sloc on a local path and return SLOC metrics (code lines, comment lines, functions, test count, per-language breakdown).

tools.name: get_metrics_latest
tools.description: Fetch the most recent scan metrics from a running oxide-sloc server.

tools.name: get_metrics_history
tools.description: Fetch time-series scan history (timestamps, git info, SLOC trend) from a running server.

tools.name: get_run_metrics
tools.description: Fetch metrics for a specific run_id from a running server.

tools.name: compare_runs
tools.description: Compare two oxide-sloc JSON result files and return a delta summary of SLOC changes.

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Verify a running oxide-sloc server is reachable and return its version.

tools.name: ingest_result
tools.description: POST an AnalysisRun JSON result into a running server's registry for storage and reporting.
